name: Unisunbot
name_zh: 浙江和晖机器人技术有限公司
summary: Unisunbot develops robot control systems, servo drives and integrated joints for quadruped, humanoid and industrial robots. The Hangzhou company combines motion-control hardware with real-time operating systems and learning-based control software. Its current portfolio includes joint-drive boards, planetary joint modules and dedicated quadruped and humanoid controllers.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
